decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper fits the established construction range and shows no sign of falling short of aspirations, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The articulated dumper uses existing engineering and service capabilities, and with no evidence of a shortfall it is kept while results mature.
The material lift line is close to the core business and reports a major rental order, so its results clearly exceed aspirations.
Although distant from the core, the mining loader shows strong field results (1,000 hours in 7 months), and the firm's slack from growth lets it carry the product despite remaining uncertainty.
